test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that correctly expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Why didn’t she bring her son to my house?

options.text: Why wasn’t her son brought by her to my house?
Why isn’t her son brought to my house?
Why wasn’t her son brought to my house?
Why isn’t her son brought by you to my house?

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Why didn’t she bring her son to my house?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "her son" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "didn’t bring" to "wasn’t brought" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "her."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Why wasn’t her son brought by her to my house?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Why isn’t her son brought to my house?" – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"Why wasn’t her son brought to my house?" – Missing the agent "by her."
 
• **Option 4: **"Why isn’t her son brought by you to my house?" – Incorrect tense and incorrect agent.

``
